product_one_liner.value: Pack helps HR leaders map workforce skills, assess gaps and deliver personalized AI-powered development, coaching and mentoring aligned with business goals.

pricing_page.notes: No public Pack pricing page was located; /pricing was unavailable. The Solutions page contains apparent unrelated Maze template pricing, not identifiable Pack plans.

employee_band.notes: Company reported almost 40 team members on January 20, 2026; a newer reliable headcount was not established.

founded_year.notes: The company’s vacancy describes Pack as born in 2022; an older LinkedIn listing gives 2021.

eng_blog.notes: Readable blog index contains HR, leadership and people-development content, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link was identified on the official site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The November 2, 2026 hiring announcement lists five openings: Full Stack Developer and sales roles; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No publicly attributable model or provider found after reviewing product and AI pages, security statements, blog and available privacy-related results; no public subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Pack explicitly claims GDPR compliance, not a GDPR certification. Its ISO 9001 claim is outside the five requested standards.

last_funding.notes: Co-leading investor reports a $6.7M Series A on December 2, 2025; this is a published USD figure, not a currency conversion.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Readable official BDR posting is corroborated by the November 2, 2026 announcement of BDR and Account Executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index’s newest entries are February 2026, before May 9, 2026; no qualifying launch announcement in the requested window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level appointment or departure could be verified within the requested window. A Head of Growth hire does not establish the requested seniority, and an ex-CTO mention does not establish a departure date.
